freeze_commit_binding: This exact manifest and source bytes must be present in the --freeze-commit supplied before any acquisition; verified through git show.

sampling.reference: official scheduled race start UTC; obtain schedule metadata only after model freeze
sampling.driver_denominator: all registered race drivers at every predeclared cutoff
sampling.partition_unit: entire event, never shuffled neighboring laps

primary_metrics.lap: prefix_median full future-lap duration MAE; no future condition/action exclusions
primary_metrics.gap: persistence MAE for last newly available nonnegative numeric interval report at fixed +90s horizon, age<=12s

secondary_metrics: The unchanged kernel reports context_median, prefix_linear and last_eligible_completed lap comparators and prefix_linear gap on the same scored targets. No holdout-based method selection.

aggregation.macro: equal arithmetic mean of per-event MAE, never pooled-target weights
aggregation.missing_event: retain reserved event with null MAE and disclose contributing count; complete-three-event MAE null unless all three score
aggregation.coverage: 23 fixed cutoffs times all historically verified registered race drivers, no posthoc active-driver filtering

feature_contract.driver_identity: same-race Jolpica Results.number plus case/accent-insensitive name-token equality; permanentNumber ignored
feature_contract.lap_completion: unchanged kernel requires same-driver next start and delayed duration completion
feature_contract.prefix: only date_start/date plus assumed publication+timing delay visible by cutoff; no archive hash/total/final result in decision features
feature_contract.stints: kernel whitelists available start, compound and initial age; archival lap_end ignored
feature_contract.partition: replace inner/outer development metadata with holdout, recompute visible_prefix and decision hashes before durable freeze

data_quality_policy.failed_request: retain body/headers/HTTP receipt and hash; no retry or alternative source
data_quality_policy.missing_endpoint: empty stream, unknown state and disclosed missing availability; never zero-fill
data_quality_policy.missing_identity: whole-event unscored; report denominator-only OpenF1 driver count when independently available
data_quality_policy.invalid_timestamp_or_required_row_fields: quarantine index+reason before kernel; raw source preserved; no inferred replacement times
data_quality_policy.null_lap_duration: retain as unfinished observation, never completed or zero-duration
data_quality_policy.duplicates_wrong_event_wrong_hash: reject event, disclose reason and all-driver missing coverage; do not deduplicate or silently repair
data_quality_policy.jolpica_laps_and_pits: paginated hash/URL/offset/count/total audit only, never forecast features; failure does not replace OpenF1 with CSV

acquisition_contract.metadata: 2024 full schedule and OpenF1 Race sessions only after this freeze
acquisition_contract.cache: exact URL/body SHA256/byte count; successful and failed immutable responses cached

freeze_order: Commit new adapter/runner/tests/manifest before any metadata or outcome GET; then acquire fixed events; durably write all 3x23 decisions before first evaluate_frozen call.
permitted_post_acquisition_changes: Reports only. No tuning, event replacement, altered sampling or frozen-source repair for this version. Integrity/source failure remains missing.
